description: This Java class provides custom assertion methods for the Bson type, allowing for comparison and validation of BSON objects within testing frameworks.

classes.name: BsonAssert
classes.description: A final class extending AbstractAssert to provide custom assertions for Bson objects, including equality checks.

methods.name: BsonAssert
methods.description: Constructor initializing the assertion for a given Bson object.

methods.name: isEqualTo
methods.description: Asserts that the actual Bson is equal to the expected Bson, using BsonUtil to convert to BsonDocument for comparison.

methods.name: assertBothOrNonNull
methods.description: Checks if either both expected and actual are null, or both are non-null, asserting accordingly.
